Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're aiming to list Liminal Cloud across AWS, GCP and Azure marketplaces in Q3 and need to expedite the vendor activation and PO routing on your side. Two asks from procurement: an accelerated PO lane for pilot purchases and clarity on the billing entity flow for marketplace-managed invoices.

Attached our W9 and a filled vendor activation worksheet for your intake team. Can you confirm the minimum paperwork Redwood needs to create a billing record and accept marketplace POs (both AWS and GCP-style purchase orders)? Also, is there a different lane or SLA for deals processed through a marketplace versus direct contracts?

High-level timeline: we hope to accept POs next week for a small pilot (1–2 small purchase orders). Who should we expect to be the point of contact for finance validation and PO acceptance?

Thanks,

— Jai Singh

Hi Jai — great to hear, and congrats on moving toward multi-marketplace listings.

Quick answers up front:
- For marketplace POs we do support an accelerated "pilot" lane for repeatable small-value POs; we can enable it for Liminal if procurement sends the standard purchase order email to marketplace@redwood.com and copies your procurement contact.
- Billing entity: to create a marketplace billing record we need a completed vendor activation worksheet, tax doc (W9 or W8), and the legal entity name that will appear on invoices.

Looping in Ben (vendor intake / finance handoff) and Laura (marketplace activation). Ben — can you confirm what additional intake fields you need for AWS vs. GCP (e.g., tax id formatting, remit-to details, marketplace payor mapping)?

I'll follow up with an accelerated checklist and a DocuSign link for signature if needed.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — details below so procurement has an actionable checklist.

Hi Jai,

Welcome — I'm Ben from Vendor Intake / FinOps. To create billing entities and accept marketplace POs we need the following minimal set (tickable):
1) Signed Vendor Activation Form (attached template) — includes legal entity name, DBA, remittance address, AP contact, tax ID type and number.
2) Tax document (W9 for US entities / W8 for foreign).
3) Copy of the master seller agreement or pointer to the DocuSign envelope (if listing requires signature).
4) Bank wiring instructions if your accounting requires settlement via ACH/wire outside marketplace flows.
5) Marketplace mapping: indicate whether Redwood should accept marketplace-managed invoices (AWS/GCP) or you prefer to route billing direct to your billing system.

For the accelerated pilot lane we can provision provisional acceptance for low-value POs (< $5k) within 24 business hours provided items 1–2 are submitted. For higher-value pilot POs we'll need a short review (2–3 business days) to validate the legal name and tax ID.

Attachment: Vendor_Activation_Form_Liminal.xlsx (please complete tab "Billing & Tax").

I'll open a ticket in our procurement intake queue and tag it as "marketplace-accelerated" once you reply with the completed form.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
FinOps / Vendor Intake
Redwood Inference
